pattern: if {f:Filter} entering causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger , that ability triggers an additional time

examples.text: If an enchantment or land entering causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time.
If a Goblin you control entering causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time.

counterExamples: If an enchantment dying causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time.
If an enchantment entering causes a triggered ability of a permanent an opponent controls to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time.
If an enchantment entering causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers two additional times.

pattern: if {f:Filter} entering the battlefield causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger , that ability triggers an additional time

examples.text: If an enchantment or land entering the battlefield causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time.
If another Goblin entering the battlefield causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time.

counterExamples: If an enchantment leaving the battlefield causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time.
If an enchantment entering the battlefield causes a triggered ability of a permanent an opponent controls to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time.
If an enchantment entering the battlefield causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers twice.
